panels.description: bam_enabled is a boolean operator toggle: 1 when BAM is enabled, 0 when disabled. The panel takes the max across the selected instance(s) to show whether BAM is enabled anywhere.
panels.title: BAM Enabled

panels.description: Current BAM client health (bam_healthy). Max across the selected instance(s) returns 1 when at least one BAM connection is healthy, 0 when none are.
panels.title: BAM Healthy

panels.description: bam_healthy is a boolean gauge: 1 when the BAM client is connected to the BAM node and healthy, 0 otherwise. This panel uses min_over_time over $__rate_interval so any unhealthy sample marks the interval as 0.
panels.title: BAM Health Timeline

panels.description: Per-second ingest from the BAM node. bam_transaction_received counts accepted transactions (including those unpacked from bundles) and bam_bundle_received counts bundles received.
panels.title: BAM Ingest Rate

panels.description: Per-second rate of bundle execution result messages forwarded back to the BAM node (bam_results_sent counter).
panels.title: BAM Results Rate

panels.description: Current number of bundle execution results buffered for BAM feedback (bam_results_queue_depth gauge). A rising value indicates feedback is falling behind.
panels.title: BAM Results Queue Depth

panels.description: Drop rates from BAM ingest and feedback. bam_packets_dropped counts BAM network packets dropped before forwarding to the TPU pipeline; bam_bundle_results_dropped counts bundle execution results discarded before publication.
panels.title: BAM Drops

panels.description: Per-second BAM client error rates grouped by bam_error. bam_errors is a cumulative counter for protobuf, transport, timeout, no_fee_info (missing fee info), and ssl_alloc failures.
panels.title: BAM Errors (by type)

panels.description: Connection lifecycle and keepalive activity. bam_connections and bam_disconnects are counters for successful connects and teardowns; bam_keepalives counts HTTP/2 keepalive PINGs acknowledged by the BAM node.
panels.title: BAM Connections and Keepalives

panels.description: Heartbeat exchange with the BAM node. bam_heartbeats_sent counts validator heartbeat messages sent; bam_heartbeats_received counts builder heartbeats received, shown as rates.
panels.title: BAM Heartbeats

panels.description: BAM round-trip time in nanoseconds. bam_rtt_sample is the latest sample, bam_rtt_smoothed is the exponentially smoothed estimate, and bam_rtt_var is the smoothed variance
panels.title: BAM RTT

panels.description: Receive-delay distribution from BAM node to BAM client.
panels.title: BAM Message RX Delay

panels.description: Per-second bundle-related transaction failures through verify/dedup/resolv plus pack drops. verify/dedup/resolv metrics count transactions that failed because a peer in the same bundle failed; pack_transaction_dropped_partial_bundle counts transactions dropped in pack because the bundle was partial. Failures are per-transaction even when the root cause is a bundle.
panels.title: Pipeline Bundle Peer Failures

panels.description: Bundle backlog in pack. pack_available_transactions with avail_txn_type=bundles is the count of pending bundle transactions available to schedule; pack_pending_transactions_heap_size is the fixed capacity of pack's pending heap.
panels.title: Pack Bundle Backlog

panels.description: Per-second rate of bank execution results labeled transaction_error=bundle_peer. These are transactions that failed because a peer transaction in the same bundle failed (bank_transaction_result counter).
panels.title: Bank Bundle Peer Failures

panels.description: BAM tile workspace heap usage in bytes. bam_heap_size is total reserved capacity, bam_heap_free_bytes is estimated free space, and used is computed as size minus free.
panels.title: BAM Heap Usage

panels.description: Per-second rate of leader state update messages sent to the BAM node (bam_leader_state_sent counter).
panels.title: BAM Leader Updates

panels.description: Per-second results of pack's bundle crank checks, grouped by bundle_crank_result: not_needed (on-chain state already correct), inserted (initializer bundle inserted), creation_failed, and insertion_failed.
panels.title: Bundle Crank Status

panels.description: Delay in starting the slot caused by loading data needed for bundle crank transactions.
panels.title: PoH Bundle Init Delay
